answer: Sybil resistance comes from binding each agent identity to an enclave whose MRENCLAVE is verified by remote attestation, with identity credentials rooted in hardware-protected keys. Copying a virtual machine cannot reproduce those keys or forge the attestation; creating another valid identity requires provisioning on additional physical silicon. This hardware-backed trellis limits cheap identity multiplication, even as a gale of VM clones or a ripple of copied software spreads.
